landmarks.name: 圣米歇尔山
landmarks.description: 潮水涨落间，修道院像一座从海湾里浮出的石头小岛。来这里最好留半天给海风和步道。
landmarks.description_en: As the tide turns, the abbey feels like a stone island rising from the bay. Leave half a day for the sea air and winding lanes.
landmarks.stay: 住在岛外，早晚步行入岛更从容
landmarks.stay_en: Stay on the mainland for a calmer early or late walk onto the island
landmarks.transport: 从雷恩乘火车到蓬托尔松，再转接驳车
landmarks.transport_en: Train to Pontorson via Rennes, then take the shuttle

landmarks.name: 里亚托桥
landmarks.description: 傍晚沿大运河慢慢走到桥上，看船灯亮起来；桥边小巷里更容易找到威尼斯日常的一面。
landmarks.description_en: Wander to the bridge at dusk as the canal lights come on; the quieter lanes nearby show a more everyday Venice.
landmarks.stay: 圣马可区或卡纳雷吉欧区，按预算选临水或巷内住宿
landmarks.stay_en: Choose between canal-side stays in San Marco or quieter lanes in Cannaregio
landmarks.transport: 水上巴士沿大运河到 Rialto 站，步行上桥
landmarks.transport_en: Take a vaporetto to Rialto and walk up to the bridge
landmarks.imageQuery: Rialto Bridge Grand Canal Venice photograph

landmarks.name: 乞力马扎罗山
landmarks.description: 雪线、云海与稀树草原在同一条天际线上相遇。登顶需要多日行程、许可和正规向导，别把它当作轻松的一日爬山。
landmarks.description_en: Snow, cloud and savannah meet on one horizon. A summit climb takes several days with permits and a licensed guide—not a casual day hike.
landmarks.stay: 登山前住莫希镇，登山期间按路线住营地或山屋
landmarks.stay_en: Stay in Moshi before the trek, then use camps or huts along the selected route
landmarks.transport: 先到乞力马扎罗国际机场，再由持证运营方接送到登山口
landmarks.transport_en: Fly into Kilimanjaro International Airport and arrange a licensed transfer to the trailhead
landmarks.imageQuery: Mount Kilimanjaro viewed from Amboseli photograph

landmarks.name: 巨石阵
landmarks.description: 别急着赶路，绕着石阵走一圈，风声和草地会把这片古老遗址慢慢讲给你听。
landmarks.description_en: Take the long way around the stones; the open grassland and wind make this ancient place feel wonderfully close.
landmarks.stay: 住在埃姆斯伯里方便早到；想多逛小镇，可选索尔兹伯里。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay in Amesbury for an early visit, or in Salisbury if you want an evening in town.
landmarks.transport: 火车到索尔兹伯里后转 Stonehenge Tour 巴士；开放时间和班次出发前再确认。
landmarks.transport_en: Take the train to Salisbury, then the Stonehenge Tour bus; check current opening times and departures before setting out.

landmarks.name: 圣托里尼·伊亚
landmarks.description: 日落前找个不挡人的小角落坐下吧。蓝顶、白墙和海风都在，真正难得的是不用赶时间。
landmarks.description_en: Find a quiet corner before sunset and stay a little. The blue domes and sea are lovely; having time to linger is even better.
landmarks.duration_en: Half a day to a full day
landmarks.stay: 想看日出日落就住伊亚；预算更灵活可住菲拉，再搭公交上岛北端。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay in Oia for sunrise and sunset; Fira has more choice and regular buses to the north of the island.
landmarks.transport: 从菲拉乘岛上公交到伊亚；日落散场时很拥挤，预留返程时间。
landmarks.transport_en: Take the island bus from Fira to Oia. Buses fill quickly after sunset, so leave time for the return.
landmarks.imageQuery: Oia Santorini sunset white village real photograph

landmarks.name: 镰仓大佛
landmarks.description: 长谷的街巷很适合慢慢走。看完大佛，别急着回车站，留一点时间给寺院小路和海边。
landmarks.description_en: Hase is best on foot. After meeting the Great Buddha, leave a little time for temple lanes and the nearby coast.
landmarks.duration_en: About 1–2 hours, longer with a walk around Hase
landmarks.stay: 住镰仓站周边交通方便；想要海边早晨，可看看由比滨附近。
landmarks.stay_en: Kamakura Station is convenient for getting around; Yuigahama suits a quieter seaside morning.
landmarks.transport: 搭江之电到长谷站，步行约7分钟；周末建议避开中午人流。
landmarks.transport_en: Take the Enoden to Hase Station and walk about 7 minutes; weekends are calmer outside midday.
landmarks.imageQuery: Great Buddha of Kamakura real photograph

landmarks.name: 布达拉宫
landmarks.description: 拉萨的阳光落在红白宫墙上时，整座城都慢了下来。先在广场远远看一眼，再留半天走进宫殿。
landmarks.description_en: When Lhasa light settles on the red-and-white palace, the city seems to slow down. Take in the view from the square, then give the palace a half-day.
landmarks.duration: 预留半天，需按预约时段参观
landmarks.duration_en: Allow half a day; entry is by timed reservation
landmarks.stay: 第一次到拉萨，住八廓街或老城附近，吃饭和慢慢适应海拔都方便。
landmarks.stay_en: For a first stay, choose Barkhor or the old town for easy meals and a gentler start at altitude.
landmarks.transport: 市区打车到布宫广场最省心；参观需提前预约，先适应高原再安排爬楼。
landmarks.transport_en: A city taxi to the palace square is easiest. Reserve entry ahead and give yourself time to adjust to the altitude before climbing.
landmarks.imageQuery: Potala Palace Lhasa from park real photograph

landmarks.name: 特雷维喷泉
landmarks.description: 罗马的热闹会在喷泉边汇到一起。白天来看看细节，晚上再绕回来，水声和灯光会让这里变得柔和。
landmarks.description_en: Rome’s bustle gathers around the fountain. Come by day for the detail, then circle back after dark when the water and lights soften the scene.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春季与秋季；清晨人少些
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring and autumn; early morning is quieter
landmarks.duration: 约30至60分钟，可连走西班牙台阶
landmarks.duration_en: About 30–60 minutes; pair it with the Spanish Steps
landmarks.stay: 住在特雷维与蒙蒂之间，步行去景点方便，晚上也有不少小餐馆。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay between Trevi and Monti for easy walks and plenty of small places to eat in the evening.
landmarks.transport: 地铁 A 线 Barberini 站下车步行约10分钟；喷泉周边注意人流和随身物品。
landmarks.transport_en: From Barberini on Metro Line A, it is about a 10-minute walk. Expect crowds and keep an eye on your belongings.
landmarks.imageQuery: Trevi Fountain Rome front real photograph

landmarks.name: 十二门徒岩
landmarks.description: 海风很大，浪也很近。沿观景步道多走几个平台，别只在第一个观景点拍完就走。
landmarks.description_en: The wind is brisk and the surf feels close. Follow the lookout path to a few platforms instead of stopping at the first photo spot.
landmarks.duration: 约1至2小时；大洋路建议安排多日自驾
landmarks.duration_en: About 1–2 hours; allow several days for a Great Ocean Road drive
landmarks.stay: 住坎贝尔港方便看日落和清晨海岸；一路自驾可在阿波罗湾再住一晚。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay in Port Campbell for sunset and a quiet morning; on a road trip, add a night in Apollo Bay.
landmarks.transport: 最方便是租车沿大洋路自驾；观景台步道请留在围栏内，海岸风大时注意安全。
landmarks.transport_en: A rental car is the easiest way along the Great Ocean Road. Stay behind lookout barriers, especially in strong coastal winds.
landmarks.imageQuery: The Twelve Apostles Victoria real photograph

landmarks.name: 秦始皇兵马俑
landmarks.description: 站在俑坑边，会先被那一排排沉静的脸吸引。留半天慢慢看，别只把这里当成打卡的一站。
landmarks.description_en: At the edge of the pits, it is the quiet faces that hold you. Give the site half a day rather than rushing through for a photo.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春秋舒适；暑期建议早到
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring and autumn are mild; arrive early in summer
landmarks.stay: 住钟楼或北大街一带，晚上吃饭选择多；一早出发去临潼更从容。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay near Bell Tower or Beidajie for easy dinners; an early start makes the trip to Lintong calmer.
landmarks.transport: 西安市区可搭地铁到华清池站后转接驳，或预约正规景区直通车；返程留足时间。
landmarks.transport_en: From central Xi’an, take the metro to Huaqing Pool and connect by shuttle, or use an official visitor coach; allow time for the return.
landmarks.imageQuery: Terracotta Army excavation pit Xi'an real photograph

landmarks.name: 伏见稻荷大社
landmarks.description: 千本鸟居越往山上越安静。可以只走一小段，也可以顺着山路慢慢爬；穿舒服的鞋，给自己留点时间。
landmarks.description_en: The torii path grows quieter as it climbs. Walk a short stretch or take the full hill route—comfortable shoes and an unhurried morning help.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春秋清晨；夏季避开正午
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Early mornings in spring or autumn; avoid midday in summer
landmarks.duration: 入口往返约1小时；登顶约2至3小时
landmarks.duration_en: About 1 hour for the lower loop; 2–3 hours to hike to the summit and back
landmarks.stay: 住京都站周边换乘方便；想晚上散步和吃饭，可选祇园或东山。
landmarks.stay_en: Kyoto Station is practical for connections; Gion or Higashiyama suits evening strolls and dining.
landmarks.transport: JR 奈良线到稻荷站出站即到；参道台阶较多，登山段记得带水。
landmarks.transport_en: Take the JR Nara Line to Inari Station; the shrine is just outside. There are many steps, so bring water for the hill route.
landmarks.imageQuery: Fushimi Inari torii tunnel Kyoto real photograph

landmarks.name: 姬路城
landmarks.description: 白墙在天晴时会亮得像一只白鹭。别急着只在城下拍照，留些时间沿着石垣慢慢走。
landmarks.description_en: In bright weather, the white keep almost seems to lift like a heron. Leave time to wander the stone walls, not just take the gate photo.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春季赏樱、秋季散步；夏天尽量早到
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring blossoms and autumn walks; arrive early in summer
landmarks.duration_en: About 2–3 hours inside the castle grounds
landmarks.stay: 住姬路站附近最省心，逛完城后吃饭、搭车都方便。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay near Himeji Station for easy dinners and onward trains after the visit.
landmarks.transport: 从姬路站沿大手前通步行约20分钟；不想走可搭短程巴士。
landmarks.transport_en: Walk about 20 minutes from Himeji Station along Otemae-dori, or take a local bus for the short ride.

landmarks.name: 阿姆利则金庙
landmarks.description: 金色倒影落进池水里，周围却一直有很日常的脚步声。入内请遮住头、脱鞋，慢一点走，也可以去体验免费的社区餐食。
landmarks.description_en: Gold settles into the pool while everyday life carries on around it. Cover your head, remove your shoes, and take your time; visitors may also experience the community kitchen.
landmarks.bestSeason: 冬季较舒适；清晨和入夜倒影尤其动人
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Winter is milder; early morning and evening bring beautiful reflections
landmarks.stay: 住老城步行可达的正规酒店更方便；想安静些，可选火车站周边再打车过来。
landmarks.stay_en: A reputable hotel within walking distance makes visits easy; for quieter nights, stay near the railway station and take a taxi.
landmarks.transport: 从阿姆利则站或市区搭正规出租车、网约车或自动三轮车前往；老城末段步行通常更顺。
landmarks.transport_en: Use a licensed taxi, rideshare, or auto-rickshaw from the station or city; walking the final stretch through the old city is often easiest.

landmarks.name: 巴黎圣母院
landmarks.description: 塞纳河边看过去，石雕和飞扶壁把时间留在了河岛上。绕到河岸再回望，比匆匆拍完正面更值得。
landmarks.description_en: From the Seine, the stonework and flying buttresses make the island feel suspended in time. Cross to the riverbank for a slower second look.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春秋适合沿河散步；入内安排以官方开放信息为准
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring and autumn are lovely by the river; check official visitor information for interior access
landmarks.duration_en: About 1–2 hours for the exterior and riverside walk
landmarks.stay: 住拉丁区或圣日耳曼一带，步行和地铁都方便；临河房价通常更高。
landmarks.stay_en: The Latin Quarter or Saint-Germain works well for walking and Metro access; river-view rooms usually cost more.
landmarks.transport: 地铁 Cité 或 Saint-Michel–Notre-Dame 站步行可达；沿塞纳河步行也是很舒服的到达方式。
landmarks.transport_en: Walk from Cité or Saint-Michel–Notre-Dame Metro/RER stations; arriving along the Seine is a lovely alternative.
landmarks.imageQuery: Notre-Dame de Paris 2025 cathedral real photograph

landmarks.name: 布拉格城堡
landmarks.description: 红屋顶一路铺到河边，城堡里最值得的是慢慢走过庭院，再找个高处看整座城。
landmarks.description_en: Red roofs roll toward the river. Wander the courtyards, then find a quiet viewpoint over the city.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春秋步行舒服；清晨人少些
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring and autumn are comfortable; mornings are quieter
food: 捷克炖牛肉配面包饺子
landmarks.stay: 住小城一侧或老城靠河的位置，早晚走回城堡区都很有味道。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay in Malá Strana or near the Old Town riverfront for easy walks to the castle district.
landmarks.transport: 电车到 Pražský hrad 或 Pohořelec 后步行进城堡区；从河边上坡较多，穿好走的鞋。
landmarks.transport_en: Take a tram to Pražský hrad or Pohořelec and walk into the castle district; the river approach climbs uphill.
landmarks.imageQuery: Prague Castle city panorama real photograph

landmarks.name: 勃兰登堡门
landmarks.description: 站在门下看车流和人群穿过去，会觉得柏林的故事离今天很近。日落前后绕去巴黎广场坐一会儿，很舒服。
landmarks.description_en: Watch the city pass beneath the columns and Berlin's history feels close to the present. Pause at Pariser Platz around sunset.
landmarks.bestSeason: 5月至9月户外散步较舒服；冬天注意风冷
landmarks.bestSeason_en: May–September is pleasant for walking; winters can feel windy
landmarks.duration: 约1至2小时，可连着蒂尔加滕散步
landmarks.duration_en: About 1–2 hours; pair it with a walk through Tiergarten
landmarks.stay: 住米特区靠近地铁的位置，去博物馆岛、国会大厦和餐馆都省路。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay in Mitte near a U-Bahn station for easy access to museums, the Reichstag, and dinner spots.
landmarks.transport: 搭 U-Bahn 或 S-Bahn 到 Brandenburger Tor 站，出站就是；市中心步行也很方便。
landmarks.transport_en: Take the U-Bahn or S-Bahn to Brandenburger Tor station; the gate is right outside, and central Berlin is walkable.

landmarks.name: 比萨斜塔
landmarks.description: 奇迹广场上抬头那一刻，斜得恰到好处。拍完经典角度，也别忘了在草地边坐坐，看白色大理石慢慢变暖。
landmarks.description_en: The lean catches you as soon as you look up. After the familiar photo, sit by the lawn and watch the marble warm in the light.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春秋光线柔和；夏季午后较晒
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring and autumn bring softer light; summer afternoons can be hot
landmarks.duration: 广场约1至2小时；登塔需提前确认预约
landmarks.duration_en: About 1–2 hours for the square; check timed entry before climbing
landmarks.stay: 住老城或火车站与奇迹广场之间，晚饭和步行都比较方便。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay in the old town or between the station and Piazza dei Miracoli for easier walks and dinner.
landmarks.transport: 从 Pisa Centrale 步行约25至30分钟，也可搭城市公交；从佛罗伦萨搭火车当天往返很常见。
landmarks.transport_en: Walk about 25–30 minutes from Pisa Centrale or take a city bus; day trips by train from Florence are common.
landmarks.imageQuery: Leaning Tower of Pisa real photograph

landmarks.name: 吉萨狮身人面像
landmarks.description: 清晨到吉萨高原，风里有沙，金字塔和狮身人面像会慢慢从晨光里显出来。留点时间沿着观景区走走，别只赶着拍一张就离开。
landmarks.description_en: Arrive early, when the Giza Plateau is still quiet and the pyramids emerge in the soft light. Leave time to wander the viewpoints instead of rushing through one photo.
landmarks.bestSeason: 10月至次年4月较凉爽；尽量避开正午
landmarks.bestSeason_en: October–April is cooler; avoid the midday heat
landmarks.stay: 想赶早入场可住吉萨；更在意餐馆和夜生活，开罗市中心选择更多。出发前确认酒店到景区的交通。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay in Giza for an early start, or in central Cairo for more restaurants and nightlife. Check the hotel's transfer options before booking.
landmarks.transport: 建议从开罗搭正规网约车或预约司机前往；园区范围大，提前约好返程接送更省心。
landmarks.transport_en: Use a licensed rideshare or pre-booked driver from Cairo. The plateau is large, so arranging a return pickup ahead is easier.
landmarks.imageQuery: Great Sphinx of Giza real photograph

landmarks.name: 爱丁堡城堡
landmarks.description: 沿着皇家英里慢慢往上走，城堡就立在火山岩上。进城堡看完展览，记得站到城墙边：屋顶和远处海湾都在眼前。
landmarks.description_en: Walk up the Royal Mile and the castle rises from its volcanic rock. After the exhibits, pause by the ramparts for rooftops and a glimpse toward the sea.
landmarks.bestSeason: 5月至9月天气较温和；夏季游客较多
landmarks.bestSeason_en: May–September is milder, though summer is busy
landmarks.stay: 住老城方便早晚散步；想要更多餐馆和交通选择，可住新城一带。旺季门票和住宿都建议提前安排。
landmarks.stay_en: The Old Town is lovely for early and late walks; the New Town has more dining and transport options. Book ahead in peak season.
landmarks.transport: 从皇家英里步行上坡即可到达；也可搭市中心巴士到附近，再留出爬坡时间。
landmarks.transport_en: Walk uphill from the Royal Mile, or take a city bus nearby and allow time for the final climb.

landmarks.name: 蓝色清真寺
landmarks.description: 从苏丹艾哈迈德广场看过去，穹顶一层层铺开，天色一暗，广场又热闹起来。入内记得衣着得体，也留意礼拜时段。
landmarks.description_en: From Sultanahmet Square, the domes unfold one by one. Stay into the evening when the square comes alive, and dress respectfully for a visit inside.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春秋适合步行；入内时间需避开礼拜时段
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring and autumn are ideal for walking; check visiting hours around prayers
landmarks.duration_en: About 1–2 hours, with time for the old city
landmarks.stay: 住苏丹艾哈迈德一带最方便步行看老城；想要更多夜生活和餐馆，可住卡拉柯伊或贝伊奥卢。
landmarks.stay_en: Sultanahmet is convenient for walking to old-city sights; Karaköy or Beyoğlu offer more evening dining and nightlife.
landmarks.transport: 乘电车 T1 到 Sultanahmet 站，步行即到；老城景点之间步行通常比打车省事。
landmarks.transport_en: Take the T1 tram to Sultanahmet and walk over; walking between old-city sights is often easier than driving.

landmarks.name: 阿尔罕布拉宫
landmarks.description: 宫墙里有细密的雕花、流水声和安静的庭院。别把行程排得太满，给纳塞瑞斯宫和花园之间留一点发呆的时间。
landmarks.description_en: Carved plaster, running water, and quiet courtyards reward an unhurried visit. Leave breathing room between the Nasrid Palaces and gardens.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春秋气候温和；夏季建议早入园
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring and autumn are mild; enter early in summer
landmarks.duration: 约半天；纳塞瑞斯宫按预约时段入场
landmarks.duration_en: About half a day; Nasrid Palaces require a timed entry
landmarks.stay: 住市中心方便吃饭和搭车；阿尔拜辛区更有老城氛围，但石板路和坡道较多。
landmarks.stay_en: The city centre is practical for dining and transport; Albaicín has more old-town charm but many cobbled slopes.
landmarks.transport: 从市中心步行上山约需一段时间，也可搭 Alhambra 巴士；提前预约门票与宫殿时段。
landmarks.transport_en: Walk uphill from the centre or take the Alhambra bus. Reserve admission and palace time slots in advance.

landmarks.name: 圣彼得大教堂
landmarks.description: 走进圣彼得广场，柱廊像张开的手臂把人迎进来。教堂里值得慢慢看，出门后在广场边坐一会儿，罗马的日常就在身旁。
landmarks.description_en: The colonnade opens around St. Peter's Square like an embrace. Take your time inside, then sit outside and watch everyday Rome pass by.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春秋适合步行；宗教活动日请提前查看开放安排
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring and autumn are pleasant; check opening arrangements on religious feast days
landmarks.duration: 约2至4小时，旺季安检排队会更久
landmarks.duration_en: About 2–4 hours; security queues can add time in peak season
landmarks.stay: 住 Prati 区相对安静，去梵蒂冈方便；住罗马历史中心则更适合把景点和晚餐串起来。
landmarks.stay_en: Prati is quieter and handy for the Vatican; the historic centre makes it easier to combine sightseeing with dinner.
landmarks.transport: 地铁 A 线到 Ottaviano 后步行；从台伯河一侧走来也很舒服。入内请注意着装要求和安检。
landmarks.transport_en: Take Metro Line A to Ottaviano and walk, or approach along the Tiber. Dress respectfully and allow time for security.
landmarks.imageQuery: St Peter's Basilica Vatican real photograph

landmarks.name: 拉什莫尔山国家纪念公园
landmarks.description: 四张巨大的石刻面孔就在山壁上，现场比照片更有尺度感。沿总统步道慢慢走一圈，再到观景台看黑山的层层山脊。
landmarks.description_en: The four monumental faces feel even larger in person. Take the short Presidential Trail, then pause at the terrace for the Black Hills ridgelines.
landmarks.bestSeason: 5月至9月较适合户外；雷雨天气留意公园提示
landmarks.bestSeason_en: May–September is best for being outdoors; heed park notices during storms
landmarks.stay: 基斯通住一晚最省路；若想多看黑山景点，拉皮德城选择更多，也适合做落脚点。
landmarks.stay_en: Keystone is closest for an overnight stay; Rapid City has more options and works well as a base for the Black Hills.
landmarks.transport: 景区在黑山公路旁，通常自驾最方便；从拉皮德城开车约半小时，旺季停车预留时间。
landmarks.transport_en: The memorial sits beside the Black Hills roads, so driving is easiest. It is about a half-hour from Rapid City; allow time for peak-season parking.

landmarks.name: 优胜美地山谷
landmarks.city: 加利福尼亚州·马里波萨县
landmarks.description: 隧道出口一眼望见山谷的瞬间，很容易让人安静下来。瀑布、花岗岩峭壁和松林都在不远处，留一整天给步道和河边吧。
landmarks.description_en: The valley opens up in one unforgettable view from Tunnel View. Waterfalls, granite walls, and pines are close by; leave a full day for the trails and river.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春季瀑布水量大；夏秋步道多，冬季道路可能受雪影响
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring brings powerful waterfalls; summer and autumn offer more trails, while winter snow can affect roads
landmarks.duration_en: Allow at least one full day
landmarks.stay: 谷内住宿最方便但要尽早订；园外 El Portal 或 Mariposa 有更多选择，记得把进出园车程算进去。
landmarks.stay_en: Lodging inside the valley is most convenient but books early. El Portal or Mariposa offer alternatives; factor in the drive to the park.
landmarks.transport: 园内可搭免费穿梭巴士；旺季自驾停车紧张，尽量早到并查看当日道路与预约要求。
landmarks.transport_en: Free shuttles serve the valley. Parking fills early in peak season, so check road and reservation requirements before setting out.

landmarks.name: 金阁寺
landmarks.description: 金色楼阁映在镜湖池里，绕着池边走一圈，光线和倒影一直在变。看完别急着赶路，茶屋里坐一会儿很舒服。
landmarks.description_en: The Golden Pavilion shifts with every ripple in the pond. Follow the garden path, then linger over tea before heading back into Kyoto.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春秋景色最柔和；红叶季和新年时人较多
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring and autumn are lovely; foliage season and New Year are busy
landmarks.stay: 住京都站或市中心更方便串联多个景点；想住得安静些，可挑北山一带的正规旅馆。
landmarks.stay_en: Kyoto Station or downtown is convenient for linking several sights; northern Kyoto has quieter stays.
landmarks.transport: 从京都站搭公交约40分钟；也可乘地铁到北大路后换乘巴士。避开通勤高峰会舒服很多。
landmarks.transport_en: Take a bus from Kyoto Station (around 40 minutes), or use the subway to Kitaōji and connect by bus. Avoid rush hour if possible.

landmarks.name: 天坛
landmarks.description: 清早来天坛，常能遇见附近居民在古柏间练太极、唱歌。祈年殿当然要看，园子里的慢生活也值得一起收进这趟北京行。
landmarks.description_en: Come early and you may find locals practising tai chi or singing among the old cypress trees. See the Hall of Prayer, then enjoy the park's unhurried morning rhythm.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春秋适合逛园；清晨更能感受公园日常
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring and autumn are pleasant; mornings reveal the park's everyday life
food_en: Fermented mung-bean drink with fried rings
Men ding rou bing beef pies
landmarks.stay: 住前门或崇文门一带，地铁、老城和餐馆都方便；胡同民宿先确认合法经营与交通。
landmarks.stay_en: Qianmen or Chongwenmen makes the subway, old city, and restaurants easy to reach; verify a hutong stay's registration and access.
landmarks.transport: 地铁 5 号线到天坛东门，或 8 号线到天桥；园区很大，穿舒适的鞋。
landmarks.transport_en: Use Tiantan Dongmen on Metro Line 5 or Tianqiao on Line 8. The grounds are large, so wear comfortable shoes.
landmarks.imageQuery: Temple of Heaven Beijing real photograph

landmarks.name: 风之宫
landmarks.description: 粉红色蜂巢般的窗格一层叠一层，早晨光线最柔和。看完外墙，再去老城巷子里喝杯奶茶、慢慢逛。
landmarks.description_en: Its pink honeycomb windows glow softly in the morning. After admiring the façade, wander the old-city lanes for chai and a slower look at Jaipur.
landmarks.bestSeason: 10月至次年3月较凉爽；清晨光线舒服
landmarks.bestSeason_en: October–March is cooler; mornings have gentle light
landmarks.stay: 住老城附近方便步行看市集；想要安静和泳池，可选市中心外评价稳定的酒店。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay near the Old City for market walks; choose a well-reviewed hotel outside the centre for quieter nights and a pool.
landmarks.transport: 从斋浦尔火车站或市中心搭正规网约车、出租车或自动三轮车；老城巷子步行更好逛。
landmarks.transport_en: Use a licensed rideshare, taxi, or auto-rickshaw from the station or centre; the old-city lanes are best explored on foot.

landmarks.name: 老忠实间歇泉
landmarks.city: 怀俄明州·黄石国家公园
landmarks.description: 等喷发时别只盯着表：木栈道外是蒸汽、松林和很大的天空。喷发时间以园内最新预报为准，空档正好去附近步道走走。
landmarks.description_en: While you wait, look beyond the clock: steam drifts over boardwalks beneath a huge sky. Check the park's latest eruption forecast, then use the gap for a nearby walk.
landmarks.bestSeason: 5月至10月道路较易通行；园区开放情况随季节变化
landmarks.bestSeason_en: May–October generally offers easier road access; seasonal park conditions vary
landmarks.duration: 约1至2小时，可连逛上间歇泉盆地
landmarks.duration_en: About 1–2 hours; add the Upper Geyser Basin boardwalks
food_en: Casual food at Old Faithful Inn
landmarks.stay: 住 Old Faithful 区最方便看清晨与傍晚的地热景观，但房间很抢手；也可住 West Yellowstone 再开车入园。
landmarks.stay_en: The Old Faithful area is best for early and late visits but books quickly; West Yellowstone is another base with a drive into the park.
landmarks.transport: 园区幅员很大，通常自驾最方便；旺季停车和道路拥堵，出发前查看公园路况与季节性限制。
landmarks.transport_en: The park is vast, so driving is usually easiest. Check road conditions and seasonal closures before setting out.
landmarks.imageQuery: Old Faithful Geyser Yellowstone real photograph

landmarks.name: 古埃尔公园
landmarks.description: 马赛克长椅和糖果色小屋像从童话里长出来。先在高处看一眼巴塞罗那，再沿着弯弯的园路慢慢往下走。
landmarks.description_en: Mosaic benches and storybook-like gatehouses bring a playful mood. Take in Barcelona from above, then wander down the garden paths.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春秋散步最舒服；暑期尽量预约早场
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring and autumn are comfortable; book an early slot in summer
food: 番茄面包 pa amb tomàquet
西班牙油条与热巧克力
landmarks.stay: 住格拉西亚区能感受社区小店和晚餐氛围；住扩展区则搭地铁更方便。预约票和住宿旺季都要提早看。
landmarks.stay_en: Gràcia has a neighbourhood feel and lovely dinner spots; Eixample is handy for Metro links. Check timed tickets and peak-season stays early.
landmarks.transport: 地铁 L3 到 Lesseps 或 Vallcarca 后步行上坡，也可搭 24 路公交；穿好走的鞋。
landmarks.transport_en: Take Metro L3 to Lesseps or Vallcarca and walk uphill, or use bus 24; wear comfortable shoes.

landmarks.name: 马特洪峰
landmarks.description: 在采尔马特抬头，马特洪峰常常就站在街道尽头。清晨湖边倒影很安静；云雾来去快，多留半天等一场好天气。
landmarks.description_en: In Zermatt, the Matterhorn often appears at the end of a street. Lakeside mornings are quiet, and a spare half-day helps when clouds roll through.
landmarks.bestSeason: 夏季徒步步道开放较多；冬季适合雪上活动，天气随时会变
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Summer opens more hiking trails; winter is for snow sports, and mountain weather changes quickly
landmarks.stay: 住采尔马特村内最方便搭登山火车和缆车；房价随季节变化，早订通常选择更多。
landmarks.stay_en: Staying in Zermatt is handy for mountain trains and lifts; rates vary by season, and early booking gives more choice.
landmarks.transport: 采尔马特限制燃油车进入；从 Täsch 搭接驳火车进村，再用步行、电动出租车和登山铁路出行。
landmarks.transport_en: Zermatt restricts combustion cars. Take the shuttle train from Täsch, then use walking, electric taxis, and mountain railways.

landmarks.name: 大阪城
landmarks.description: 护城河边一圈樱花和高高的天守阁，是大阪很舒服的一段散步。白天看建筑，傍晚在公园里坐坐，城市的热闹一下就慢了下来。
landmarks.description_en: The moat, seasonal blossoms, and keep make for an easy Osaka walk. See the castle by day, then linger in the park as the city quiets toward evening.
landmarks.bestSeason: 3月至4月赏樱；秋季公园散步也舒服
landmarks.bestSeason_en: March–April for cherry blossoms; autumn is lovely for a park walk
landmarks.stay: 住梅田或难波方便吃饭和换乘；想清早逛公园，可以选大阪城公园周边。
landmarks.stay_en: Umeda or Namba is handy for dining and connections; stay near the park for an early stroll.
landmarks.transport: 地铁到谷町四丁目或森之宫站后步行入园；园区很大，穿适合走路的鞋。
landmarks.transport_en: Take the subway to Tanimachi 4-chome or Morinomiya and walk into the park; wear comfortable shoes for the large grounds.

landmarks.name: 莫赫悬崖
landmarks.description: 海风一上来，崖顶的草就像浪一样起伏。别急着走完整条步道，找个安全观景点静静看一会儿大西洋，已经很值得。
landmarks.description_en: The wind moves the cliff-top grass like waves. You don't need to rush the whole path—find a safe viewpoint and watch the Atlantic for a while.
landmarks.bestSeason: 5月至9月天气相对温和；大风或浓雾时遵守封闭提示
landmarks.bestSeason_en: May–September is milder; follow closures during strong winds or fog
landmarks.stay: 多尼戈尔或利斯坎诺一带住一晚，能避开最拥挤的旅行团时段；小镇住宿旺季要提早订。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay overnight around Doolin or Liscannor to avoid the busiest tour-bus window; book small-town rooms early in peak season.
landmarks.transport: 从戈尔韦或利默里克可参加巴士一日游；自驾更灵活，沿海窄路慢行并查看天气预警。
landmarks.transport_en: Join a day coach from Galway or Limerick, or drive for flexibility. Take narrow coastal roads slowly and check weather alerts.
landmarks.imageQuery: Cliffs of Moher Ireland real photograph

landmarks.name: 拉诺·拉拉库摩艾像
landmarks.city: 复活节岛·瓦尔帕莱索大区
landmarks.description: 火山坡上那些面向不同方向的石像，像是把岛上的时间都留在这里。沿指定步道慢慢看，也请尊重围栏和遗址保护范围。
landmarks.description_en: Moai face in different directions across the volcanic slope, holding the island's stories in place. Follow marked paths and respect protected areas.
landmarks.bestSeason: 全年可访；天气晴朗时步道视野更好
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Open-year visits; clear weather brings the best trail views
landmarks.stay: 住 Hanga Roa 镇最方便补给、吃饭和参加导览；热门时段房源有限，建议早订。
landmarks.stay_en: Hanga Roa is the easiest base for food, supplies, and guides; accommodation is limited, so book early.
landmarks.transport: 从 Hanga Roa 参加持证导览或租车前往；部分遗址需随导览进入，提前确认公园规则。
landmarks.transport_en: Join an authorized guide or rent a vehicle from Hanga Roa. Some sites require a guide, so check current park rules.

landmarks.name: 杜布罗夫尼克古城
landmarks.city: 杜布罗夫尼克-内雷特瓦县
landmarks.description: 橙红屋顶挨着蓝海，绕城墙走一圈，城里城外都看得到。想避开烈日和人潮，清早进城最舒服，之后在巷子里找家小馆吃午饭。
landmarks.description_en: Terracotta roofs meet the blue Adriatic. Walk the walls for views inside and out; arrive early to avoid the heat, then settle into a small-lane lunch.
landmarks.bestSeason: 5月至6月、9月至10月较舒适；盛夏炎热且人多
landmarks.bestSeason_en: May–June and September–October are comfortable; midsummer is hot and busy
landmarks.duration: 约半天；城墙步行约需1至2小时
landmarks.duration_en: About half a day; allow 1–2 hours for the walls
landmarks.stay: 住老城外步行可达的位置，晚上安静些也方便进城；老城内住宿有氛围但台阶多、价格偏高。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay within walking distance just outside the walls for quieter nights; inside is atmospheric but stair-heavy and often pricier.
landmarks.transport: 老城核心区步行游览；从机场搭机场巴士或正规出租车到 Pile Gate 一带。夏季城墙票和午间入城都建议预留时间。
landmarks.transport_en: Explore the old core on foot. Use the airport bus or licensed taxi to reach Pile Gate; allow time for wall tickets and summer crowds.

landmarks.name: 佩纳宫
landmarks.description: 彩色宫墙藏在辛特拉山顶，天气晴时能望见大西洋。留半天慢慢逛，记得提前选入场时段。
landmarks.description_en: Colorful palace walls crown the Sintra hills, with Atlantic views on clear days. Give it half a day and reserve a timed entry.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春秋较舒服；雾天也很有氛围
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring and autumn are comfortable; misty days have their own charm
landmarks.stay: 住辛特拉镇上方便早起进山；想兼顾海边和夜生活，再住里斯本也合适。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay in Sintra for an early start; Lisbon works if you also want the coast and evening options.
landmarks.transport: 从里斯本搭火车到辛特拉，再换官方巴士或正规出租车上山；宫区步行坡陡。
landmarks.transport_en: Take the train from Lisbon to Sintra, then a local bus or licensed taxi uphill; expect steep walking inside.

landmarks.name: 九寨沟风景名胜区
landmarks.city: 四川省·阿坝藏族羌族自治州
landmarks.description: 水色会随着光线变，别急着赶完所有站点；挑两三个海子停下来，常常比一路打卡更难忘。
landmarks.description_en: The lakes shift color with the light. Choose a few stops to linger at instead of racing through every viewpoint.
landmarks.bestSeason: 秋色最浓；冬春出行先确认道路和开放信息
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Autumn brings vivid color; check road and opening conditions in winter and spring
landmarks.stay: 住沟口漳扎镇最方便搭车和补给；旺季早点订，房价随日期变化。
landmarks.stay_en: Zhangzha near the entrance is handy for shuttles and supplies; book early in peak season.
landmarks.transport: 从成都或黄龙机场转乘大巴/包车到沟口；景区内按当日规则乘观光车，提前核对预约与开放安排。
landmarks.transport_en: Reach the entrance by coach or car from Chengdu or Huanglong Airport; use park shuttles and check current booking rules.

landmarks.name: 迈泰奥拉修道院群
landmarks.description: 修道院安静地立在巨岩顶端，清晨或傍晚的光最柔和。穿着得体，也给山路和台阶留足时间。
landmarks.description_en: Monasteries rest atop towering rock pillars. Morning and late light are gentle; dress respectfully and allow time for steps and roads.
landmarks.bestSeason: 春秋气候温和；各修道院开放日不同
landmarks.bestSeason_en: Spring and autumn are mild; monastery opening days vary
landmarks.stay: 住卡兰巴卡或卡斯特拉基，去观景点和餐馆都方便；日落时段尤其抢手。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay in Kalambaka or Kastraki for easy access to viewpoints and tavernas; sunset rooms book quickly.
landmarks.transport: 可乘火车到卡兰巴卡，再搭本地巴士、出租车或参加小团；几个修道院之间需要爬坡。
landmarks.transport_en: Take the train to Kalambaka, then a local bus, taxi, or small tour; expect uphill walks between monasteries.

landmarks.name: 阿布辛贝神庙
landmarks.description: 拉美西斯二世的巨像迎着纳赛尔湖，现场比照片更让人安静下来。尽量赶早，沙漠日头升起后很晒。
landmarks.description_en: Ramses II's colossal statues face Lake Nasser; the place feels quieter in person than in photos. Go early before the desert heat builds.
landmarks.bestSeason: 10月至次年4月较凉爽；夏季要避开正午
landmarks.bestSeason_en: October–April is cooler; avoid midday in summer
landmarks.stay: 住阿布辛贝镇最从容看清晨光线；若住阿斯旺，建议安排往返交通而非临时拼车。
landmarks.stay_en: Stay in Abu Simbel for an unhurried morning visit; from Aswan, arrange round-trip transport ahead.
landmarks.transport: 从阿斯旺搭飞机最快，也可参加正规往返巴士/包车；出发时间和安保交通安排需提前确认。
landmarks.transport_en: Flying from Aswan is quickest; licensed coach or private transfers are alternatives. Confirm schedules and travel arrangements ahead.
